stimulus.body: A formula in 4 variables is true on exactly 4 of the assignments that set a designated variable true. How many such assignments are there?

questions.stem: A formula in 4 variables is true on exactly 4 of the assignments that set a designated variable true. How many such assignments are there?

options.misconception: Wrong belief "lowers the number of required true assignments by one" gives 4, not 1.
Wrong belief "removes the designated variable from the count" gives 0, not 1.
Wrong belief "treats the choice as ordered" gives 24, not 1.

questions.explanation: Fix the designated variable as true, then choose the remaining 3 true positions among the other 3 variables, giving C(4-1,4-1) which equals 1 by the symmetry of binomial coefficients.
questions.hint: After fixing one variable, choose the rest with a binomial coefficient.

questions.stem: A Boolean expression in 8 variables depends on only 6 of them. How many minterms are needed in its full disjunctive normal form?

questions.hint: Minterms are indexed by assignments to the essential variables only.
